biotools.summary:
Life science search engine providing access to 80M+ articles, from PubMed and OpenAlex, through complementary search pathways. 
Combines classical keyword search with AI-assisted exploration, including semantic keyword grouping, knowledge graph visualization, and AI-driven summarization. All AI-generated insights are traceable to source articles. Designed to support transparent, user-steered literature exploration for biology and biomedical research. Currently in early access.
